c8891440.notes: Blue bilingual Spanish/Quechua hanging street sign of the Municipalidad Provincial del Cusco with the Inca sun-disc emblem; 'Pte.' = Puente, Quechua 'chaka' = bridge.

c8933283.notes: Blue-and-white tile street plaque on an Inca stone wall in Cusco (street of the Twelve-Angled Stone). Spelled 'Hathunrumiyoq' on the plaque (map spelling usually Hatunrumiyoc). Gold sun-disc sticker top right.

c117895471.notes: Blue-and-white tile street plaque in Cusco; a glaze blob after the final 'a' looks like a comma, and the 'i' of 'Via' has a stray glaze mark above it (not an accent). Gold sun-disc sticker top right.

c15776095.notes: Red wooden board with white routed letters on a stone wall at the Lanzón gallery entrance, Chavín de Huántar (no accents). Flash photo, slightly soft.

c46495665.notes: Barrington-sponsored tile plaque in Lima's historic centre: modern name 'JR. ANCASH CUADRA 2' on top, historic name 'Calle del Rastro de San Francisco' in decorative letters (the DE is a small D-with-E ligature), explanatory text, 'Ceram Iturry' maker mark. Painted paint-stratigraphy test patches at right are a distractor.

c46495712.notes: Barrington-sponsored tile plaque on an orange wall in central Lima: modern name 'Jr. de la Union, cuadra 4' plus historic 'Calle de Mercaderes'. Same plaque series as c46495665 but a different street.

lines.text: DESDE DONDE SE OBSERVABA LA HUERTA Y LAS CELDAS

c46618924.notes: Two tile plaques in Trujillo: upper Barrington plaque with Trujillo coat of arms (historic 'Calle del Mirador de Santa Clara', DE written as a D-with-E ligature, 'Ceram Iturry Lima-Perú' maker mark); lower green-and-white municipal plaque with left arrow and a Cerveza Pilsen Trujillo emblem.

c46942687.notes: Two green street blades on a pole in Tumbes with block numbers and arrows; city coat of arms at right (ring text 'KAROLI CESARIS AUSPITIO ET LABORE INGENIO AC IMPENSA DUCIS PIZARRO INVENTA ET PACATA', small). Upper blade is shaded and partly faded. Torn posters on the poles ('ATENCIÓN TUMBES !!!', 'SOY + PRODUCCIONES') are distractors.
